active_mission.meaning: Phase 2 = proof. Diagnosis is the active mission.

civic_deliberation.status: APPROVED PARALLEL / NOT ACTIVE IN THIS MISSION
civic_deliberation.rule: No public feedback backend touches the unprotected Build Board.

honest_progress_rules: Do not confuse scaffolding with proof
Modeling remains 0% until real models exist
Legal review remains 0% until real legal review exists
Do not invent sources, baseline values, or claim support

diagnosis_brief_three_layer_rule.text: Every diagnosis brief must distinguish three layers: what the data directly establishes, what may reasonably be inferred, and what Constitutional Capitalism normatively concludes.
diagnosis_brief_three_layer_rule.purpose: Prevent research from quietly turning into advocacy.
diagnosis_brief_three_layer_rule.effective: immediate for new and revised briefs

acceptance_criteria.note: Burt should not call this phase complete merely because architecture, routes, and files exist.
minimum_completion_requires: the eight priority domains receiving substantive sourced first passes
contrary evidence recorded where it exists
a meaningful subset of baseline metrics populated with verified data
the public evidence surfaces rendering source-backed content
the Build Board accurately reporting gaps
all new schemas and validators passing
a full source and claim audit
green gate, commit, push, and verified deployments

priority_domains.rule: Eight priority domains receive real sourcing in this mission; remaining domains may honestly roll into Phase 2.1
priority_domains.note: Priority set established in earlier Phase 2 foundation work; architecture expansions after Phase 1 are developing doctrine and research agenda until sourced

doctrine_capture_requirement.rule: New ideas developed after Phase 1 must be captured as developing doctrine, not treated as final or fully researched.

system_interdependencies.purpose: Map cross-domain relationships so research does not invent unsupported causal chains or double-count benefits.
